# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework (OUTER). Generated by gen_territory_outer.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- family of kings
# BYZ scope. Every 6 months (monthly pulse with a timer): every ranked country, and every country that had a rank or
# a dignity, gets its rank variable, visible modifier and opinions renewed. Opinions are removed and added again,
# so they never stack and lapse 30 months after a country loses its rank.
oe_tw_rank_refresh = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tw_byz
    every_country = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tw_rank has_variable = oe_tw_titled oe_tw_ranked = yes } }
        oe_tw_rank_apply = yes
    }
}
# Country scope; scope:oe_tw_byz = BYZ.
oe_tw_rank_apply = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tw_rc
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tw_byz }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_rank } remove_variable = oe_tw_rank }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
        scope:oe_tw_byz = { if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
        scope:oe_tw_byz = { if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
        scope:oe_tw_byz = { if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } } }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_tw_rank_son = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_rank value = 1 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod years = -1 } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz }
            scope:oe_tw_byz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_tw_rank_brother = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_rank value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod years = -1 } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz }
            scope:oe_tw_byz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_tw_rank_friend = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_rank value = 3 }
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod } } add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod years = -1 } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz }
            scope:oe_tw_byz = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_byz target = scope:oe_tw_rc } }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_son_mod } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_brother_mod } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_rank_friend_mod }
        }
        oe_tw_title_sync = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } scope:oe_tw_byz = { set_variable = oe_tw_any_titled } }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- court dignities
# Character scope. Takes back every dignity of this track (before a higher one is conferred).
oe_tw_clear_titles = { if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } remove_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_sebastokrator } remove_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_sebastokrator } if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_kaisar } remove_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_kaisar } if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_protosebastos } remove_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_protosebastos } }
# Country scope. Removes the four 'ruler made ...' country modifiers.
oe_tw_clear_court = { if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_despotes } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_despotes } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_sebastokrator } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_sebastokrator } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_kaisar } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_kaisar } if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_protosebastos } remove_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_protosebastos } }
# Country scope. var:oe_tw_titled and the country modifier follow the current ruler's dignity (the highest one).
oe_tw_title_sync = {
    if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 1 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_despotes } } oe_tw_clear_court = yes add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_despotes years = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_sebastokrator } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 2 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_sebastokrator } } oe_tw_clear_court = yes add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_sebastokrator years = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_kaisar } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 3 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_kaisar } } oe_tw_clear_court = yes add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_kaisar years = -1 } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_protosebastos } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 4 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_tw_court_protosebastos } } oe_tw_clear_court = yes add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_protosebastos years = -1 } }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled } remove_variable = oe_tw_titled }
        oe_tw_clear_court = yes
    }
}
# Country scope (on_new_ruler). A new ruler does not inherit the dignity.
oe_tw_on_new_ruler = {
    oe_tw_title_sync = yes
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled } country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_tw_byz }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
    }
}
# Country scope (on_ruler_death; r10). The dignity was the dead ruler's and lapses with him: a successor does
# not inherit it (grants go to the reigning ruler only).
oe_tw_on_ruler_death = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_titled } remove_variable = oe_tw_titled }
    oe_tw_clear_court = yes
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
        c:BYZ = { save_scope_as = oe_tw_byz }
        if = { limit = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } } remove_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = scope:oe_tw_byz } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_tw_grant_target = the country. Pays 20 prestige and 8 authority and confers Despot on its ruler.
oe_tw_grant_despotes = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target }
        var:oe_tw_grant_target = { save_scope_as = oe_tw_gt }
        add_prestige = -20
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -8 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
        reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_grat_despotes target = scope:oe_tw_gt }
        scope:oe_tw_gt = {
            ruler ?= {
                oe_tw_clear_titles = yes
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes years = -1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 1 }
            oe_tw_clear_court = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_despotes years = -1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_cd years = 5 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = c:BYZ } } } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = c:BYZ } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tw.3
        }
        set_variable = oe_tw_any_titled
    }
}
# BYZ scope; var:oe_tw_grant_target = the country. Pays 15 prestige and 6 authority and confers Sebastokrator on its ruler.
oe_tw_grant_sebastokrator = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target }
        var:oe_tw_grant_target = { save_scope_as = oe_tw_gt }
        add_prestige = -15
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -6 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
        reverse_add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_grat_sebastokrator target = scope:oe_tw_gt }
        scope:oe_tw_gt = {
            ruler ?= {
                oe_tw_clear_titles = yes
                add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_title_sebastokrator years = -1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_titled value = 2 }
            oe_tw_clear_court = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_tw_court_sebastokrator years = -1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_cd years = 5 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = c:BYZ } } } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_tw_titled_op target = c:BYZ } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tw.3
        }
        set_variable = oe_tw_any_titled
    }
}

# BYZ scope, AI only (yearly). 30 % a year with prestige >= 40 and authority >= 40: honour one
# unhonoured ranked ruler (a subject first, else a Roman World member) with the highest dignity open to it
# (never kaisar); then 5 years pause.
oe_tw_ai_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_ai_cd }
            oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
            prestige >= 40
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 40 }
        }
        random = {
            chance = 30
            if = {
                limit = { any_subject = { oe_tw_ai_target = yes } }
                random_subject = { limit = { oe_tw_ai_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tw_ai_t }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = { any_international_organization_member = { oe_tw_ai_target = yes } } }
                international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = { random_international_organization_member = { limit = { oe_tw_ai_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tw_ai_t } }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_tw_ai_t }
                set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = scope:oe_tw_ai_t }
                if = { limit = { oe_tw_can_grant_despotes = yes } oe_tw_grant_despotes = yes } else_if = { limit = { oe_tw_can_grant_sebastokrator = yes } oe_tw_grant_sebastokrator = yes } else_if = { limit = { oe_tw_can_grant_protosebastos = yes } oe_tw_grant_protosebastos = yes }
                remove_variable = oe_tw_grant_target
                set_variable = { name = oe_tw_ai_cd years = 5 }
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- former provinces
# Theme scope. CONTRACT with the main session: called at the start of oe_theme_revolt_start. Marks every jurisdiction
# location still owned by BYZ as a former province (value = the theme's historical region id; the location's own
# region, or 0, when the theme has none).
oe_tw_on_revolt = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tw_rev_theme
    every_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_tw_rev_theme = { has_variable = oe_theme_region_id } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = scope:oe_tw_rev_theme.var:oe_theme_region_id }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = var:oe_theme_region }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = 0 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_age value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_lost } remove_variable = oe_tw_former_lost }
    }
}
# BYZ scope, yearly. Marked land that left BYZ and is owned by BYZ again has returned: the mark goes, fervour +1 a
# location (at most +5 a year; only while the Roman Reconquest runs) and one event per historical region.
# Marks on land that never left BYZ (the revolt did not take it) are dropped after 2 checks.
oe_tw_former_yearly = {
    save_scope_as = oe_tw_byz
    set_variable = { name = oe_tw_hope_year value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tw_ret_n value = 0 }
    # Safety net for on_location_changed_owner: land still held by the theme rebel state has been lost.
    var:oe_theme_revolt_country ?= { every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province } set_variable = oe_tw_former_lost scope:oe_tw_byz = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcb_open } } set_variable = oe_tcb_open } } } }
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_lost }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_ret_pending value = var:oe_tw_former_province }
            remove_variable = oe_tw_former_province
            remove_variable = oe_tw_former_lost
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_age } remove_variable = oe_tw_former_age }
            scope:oe_tw_byz = {
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_active has_variable = oe_tw_hope_year var:oe_tw_hope_year < 5 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_tw_hope_year add = 1 }
                    oe_rr_add_hope = { amount = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_age } } set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_age value = 0 } }
            change_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_age add = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_age var:oe_tw_former_age >= 2 }
                remove_variable = oe_tw_former_province
                remove_variable = oe_tw_former_age
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy } any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_ret_busy months = 6 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tw.2
    }
}
# BYZ scope. After a '旧省归来' event: the next region's event in 30 days while regions remain; after
# 3 events in a year the rest are cleared silently (their fervour was already counted).
oe_tw_ret_next = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_n var:oe_tw_ret_n >= 3 }
        every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending } remove_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_pending } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_ret_busy months = 6 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tw.2 days = 30 }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy } remove_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod / console, BYZ scope)
# Marks a random theme's jurisdiction as a former province that was lost, then runs the yearly check
# (fervour, event oe_tw.2). The theme itself stays; nothing else changes.
oe_tw_test_return = {
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } oe_tw_on_revolt = yes }
    every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_former_province } set_variable = oe_tw_former_lost }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy } remove_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy }
    oe_tw_former_yearly = yes
}
# Picks a random ruler who can be honoured and opens the dignity event oe_tw.1.
oe_tw_test_grant = {
    random_country = { limit = { oe_tw_grant_target_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tw_test_t }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tw_test_t }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = scope:oe_tw_test_t }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tw.1
    }
}
